hints.title: Time Monotonicity
hints.text: If all cars can be repaired in time t, they can also be repaired in any time greater than t.

hints.title: Individual Car Capacity
hints.text: A mechanic with rank r can repair integer square root of floor(t / r) cars within time t.

hints.title: Summing Across Mechanics
hints.text: In time t, total cars repaired equals the sum of int(sqrt(t // r)) over all mechanics. Check if this sum is at least cars.

hints.title: Binary Search Feasible Time Implementation

variables: cars: number of cars to repair
complexity.notes: Binary search over time space with integer square root capacity sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy priority simulation car-by-car takes O(cars * log m) which exceeds limits when cars = 10^6.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies binary search on the monotonic answer space.
